question: A stationery wholesaler received 183 boxes of notebooks, and each box contained 9 notebooks. A returned order added 53 notebooks to the same stockroom. A school then donated 22 unused notebooks, and the local paper mill sent 57 samples. The stockroom ledger records paper weight in kilograms although the delivery notes give it in grams. How many notebooks are in the stockroom?

On Friday morning a food bank's shelf held 112 tins of soup. Volunteers took 34 tins out for the breakfast run, and a supermarket delivered 46 tins before noon. In the early afternoon a matching-gift scheme doubled the number of tins on the shelf. Later that afternoon the stock was divided equally between the charity's 4 branches, and the tins staying at the main branch are the ones being followed. In the evening 51 tins were handed out at the main branch's door. The rota is written in hours although volunteers record their shifts in minutes. How many tins are left at the main branch?

On Saturday morning Lena had 150 blank badges for the fun run, while her co-organiser Owen had fewer than she did. She used 116 badges at the early registration desk, and 7 more were ruined by the rain. At midday Owen's printer produced 5 badges for every badge Lena still held. In the afternoon a sponsor sent 33 extra badges for the box. In the evening the printer ran again, turning out 8 badges for each badge then in the box. How many badges are in the box at the end of the day?

On Wednesday morning a fish market had 230 boxes of sardines. Before noon 67 boxes were sent straight to a restaurant. In the afternoon every remaining box was split into 5 trays, and by early evening each tray had been repacked into 5 small tubs. Late that evening 3414 tubs were driven to the airport. Half of the market hall was already dark by then. The auctioneer calls the sale times in hours although the porters time their runs in minutes. How many tubs are left in the market?

A theatre started its run with 217 programmes, of which 48 were handed to the cast on opening night. The printer then delivered 78 extra programmes. For the tour the company ordered 3 programmes for every one it was holding. Over the tour 693 programmes were sold. The remainder was shared equally between the company's 2 storerooms, and the north storeroom's share was set aside for the archive. The box office quotes running times in minutes although the posters give them in hours. How many programmes went into the archive?

Nadia and Peter grow chillies on neighbouring allotments, and Peter's plot always produces fewer than Nadia's. Nadia had 78 chilli plants and put in 8 more in April. Each plant gave her 8 chillies over the season. She handed 77 chillies to Peter, and 326 were sold at the allotment gate. One last chilli was carried off by a mouse, and Nadia's shed stands 12 metres from the gate. How many chillies does Nadia have left?

On Thursday morning a stadium kiosk had 109 pretzels, and the baker delivered 35 more before the gates opened. At midday head office replaced the stock, sending 5 pretzels for every pretzel the kiosk was holding. During the afternoon a rival kiosk transferred 53 pretzels across. In the evening a late van brought 33 more. Half of the counter is taken up by the coffee machine, and 42 staff worked the match. How many pretzels does the kiosk have at the end of the evening?

Sofia and Ben run a bike-repair charity, and Ben logs fewer repairs than Sofia does. Sofia collected 104 old wheels, and a scrapyard matched her haul at a rate of 2 wheels for every one she had. She scrapped 131 wheels that were beyond saving, and Ben found 8 good ones in a skip. A sponsor then funded 4 new wheels for every wheel in the workshop. The wheels were finally shared equally among the charity's 4 drop-in centres, and the harbour centre's share went straight into storage. How many wheels went into storage at the harbour centre?

On Friday morning a farm shop had 35 crates of eggs, and every crate held 6 trays. Before lunch a neighbouring farm delivered 70 more trays. In the afternoon the shop divided the trays equally between its 5 delivery rounds, and the village round is the one to follow. Early in the evening the driver picked up 18 extra trays from the dairy, and 4 trays were dropped and broken on a doorstep. The van has room for 300 trays. How many trays are on the village round now?

A cafe had 23 bags of coffee beans in the storeroom. It used 11 bags during the week, and the roaster delivered 6 more. The manager split the bags equally between the 3 branches, and the station branch's share is the one to follow. The roaster then sent that branch 3 further bags for every bag it was holding. Each bag makes 9 flasks of filter coffee, and the station branch seats 48 customers. How many flasks of filter coffee can the station branch make?

On Saturday morning Priya laid out 120 sheets of pressed flowers, while her friend Ade laid out fewer than she did. Before noon Priya's press split every sheet into 2 thinner sheets. In the early afternoon each sheet was cut into 6 cards, and later every card was scored into 3 bookmarks. Ade handed over 15 bookmarks of her own in the evening. Overnight the print shop produced 5 identical bookmarks for every bookmark on Priya's table. How many bookmarks does Priya have now?

On Tuesday morning Camille had 163 tulip bulbs, and her colleague Ben, who always grows fewer than she does, handed her 48 more. Before noon the wholesaler restocked her at a rate of 5 bulbs for every bulb she was holding. In the afternoon a garden club donated 37 bulbs. During the evening planting 144 bulbs went into the park beds. Just before dark Ben found 16 stray bulbs in his van and gave them to her. How many bulbs does Camille have now?

On Wednesday morning a paper mill had 82 reels of card, and 58 reels were shipped out before lunch. Early in the afternoon each remaining reel was slit into 8 rolls. Later that afternoon every roll was cut into 9 sheets. In the evening a customer returned 58 unused sheets, which joined the pile. Overnight the mill's press printed 9 copies of every sheet in the pile. How many sheets are in the pile now?

A village hall stored 93 folding chairs. A wedding party borrowed 25 of them, and the church took 63 more for its harvest supper. Woodworm ruined 3 of the chairs still standing in the hall. A closing-down sale at the school added 46 chairs, and a neighbour donated 22 more. Half of the hall is given over to badminton on Thursdays, and the caretaker records booking lengths in minutes although the parish notices give them in hours. How many chairs are in the village hall now?

On Sunday morning a soap workshop loaded 15 racks into the curing room, and each rack held 4 bars. By noon a second batch had doubled the number of bars in the room. In the afternoon a delivery of 54 wrapped bars joined them. In the evening the cutting machine produced 9 small bars out of every bar in the room. How many small bars are in the curing room now?

Hannah and Luis collect vinyl records, and Luis owns fewer than Hannah does. Hannah had 159 records and bought 71 at a car boot sale. Luis passed her 36 from his own shelves. She sold 192 records to a shop in town and lent 67 to her brother. Half of her living room wall is shelving, and the shop is 14 minutes away on foot. How many records does Hannah have at home now?

Aisha and Kwame run a printing co-op, and Kwame produces fewer posters than Aisha does. Aisha designed 226 artworks, and each artwork was printed as 3 posters. A damp store ruined 477 posters. A festival order then called for 9 copies of every poster still in the racks. Kwame added 14 posters of his own to the racks, and the festival collected 914 posters on opening day. The co-op measures its paper in metres although the rolls are sold in centimetres. How many posters are left in the racks?

A tile-maker loaded 98 racks into the kiln, and each rack held 5 tiles. A neighbouring workshop sent 77 finished tiles to join the batch, and 26 more were salvaged from an old order. A big hotel contract then tripled the number of tiles in the store. During transport 233 tiles were cracked and thrown away. The workshop's delivery van has done 64000 miles. How many tiles does the tile-maker have now?

A charity shop had 163 paperbacks on its shelves, and a house clearance brought in 49 more. The manager split the paperbacks evenly into 2 equal piles, sent one pile to the sister shop, and kept the other. From the pile she kept, 93 books were sold over the weekend. A publisher then donated 3 copies of every book still in that pile. How many books are in that pile now?

A phone shop received 33 boxes of chargers, and each box held 9 chargers. A fault recall took 49 chargers off the shelf, and 126 were sold in the first week. A returned order put 44 chargers back. The shop quotes charging times in minutes although the boxes are labelled in hours, and the branch has 7 members of staff. How many chargers are in the shop now?

On Monday morning a scout hall had 24 tent poles, which were shared equally between the 6 patrols; the beaver patrol's share is the one being followed. Before lunch the quartermaster issued 3 more poles for every pole that patrol held. In the afternoon a supplier delivered a further 4 poles for each pole in the patrol's store. Later the patrol split its poles evenly into 2 identical kit bags and took just one bag to camp. In the evening the camp store matched that bag over and over, leaving the patrol with 6 poles for every pole in it. The hall is booked for 90 minutes each Tuesday although the rota shows the booking in hours. How many tent poles does the patrol have at camp?

A council depot began the year with 221 rolls of pavement tape, of which 137 went to the highways team and 23 perished in the damp. A supplier then delivered 50 rolls. Each roll was cut into 8 lengths, and every length was cut again into 8 short strips. The strips were shared equally between the 6 area teams, and the north team's share is the one being followed. The depot measures tape in metres although the invoices are written in centimetres. How many strips does the north team have?

On Monday morning Ivan cracked 129 crates of walnuts, and each crate produced 9 bags of kernels. Before noon 1036 bags were sent to the wholesaler, and 28 bags were rejected as mouldy in the early afternoon. Later that afternoon Ivan's brother Petro, who always packs fewer bags than Ivan does, ran the line again and turned out 7 bags for every bag Ivan still had. In the evening a supermarket collected 330 bags. How many bags does Ivan have left?

Leah keeps more chickens than her neighbour Sam. She started the month with 29 hens, sold 12 at the market, and hatched 59 chicks that joined the flock. A friend then gave her 50 more birds. Every bird laid 9 eggs during the month, and Sam added 47 eggs of his own to her crates. A wholesaler asked for a repeat batch, so Leah supplied 2 eggs for every egg she had counted. The farm shop prices eggs in dollars although the wholesaler quotes in cents. How many eggs did Leah supply in the end?

On Sunday morning a garden centre had 169 bags of compost, and 123 bags were sold before noon. In the afternoon the supplier restocked at a rate of 4 bags for every bag left on the pallet. In the early evening a landscaper returned 68 bags. Overnight the bags were shared equally between the chain's 6 stores, and the town store's share is the one to follow. How many bags went to the town store?
